FDA ENFORCEMENT REPORT - FOOD
Recall number: F-1625-2026   Classification: Class I   Status: Ongoing
Recalling firm: Palomar Flats Farms, Salinas, CA
Product description: Romaine lettuce hearts, 3-count bags, packed 12 bags per case
Code information: All romaine lettuce harvested between August 29, 2026 and August 31, 2026 from Palomar Flats Farms (Salinas, CA). Cartons carry the grower harvest lot code.
Reason for recall: Potential contamination with Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli O157:H7, identified in irrigation water sampling adjacent to the harvested fields.
Distribution pattern: Product was sold to a packer/cooler in Salinas, CA, which repacked and further distributed it to wholesalers in CA and NV.
Product quantity: 191 cases
Recall initiation date: 2026-09-06   Report date: 2026-09-11   Voluntary: Firm initiated

Halvard Cooling & Pack Co. Issues Voluntary Recall

Halvard Cooling & Pack Co. of Salinas, CA is voluntarily recalling fresh whole slicer cucumbers, 24-count cartons. Potential contamination with Salmonella, detected in routine environmental sampling of the packing line.

Affected product: Lot codes PK260908004 and PK260909002 printed on the case label, packed September 8, 2026 and September 9, 2026.
Distributed to wholesale distributors and food service operators in CA and NV. Approximately 227 cases are involved.

The recall was initiated on September 17, 2026 in cooperation with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (recall F-1953-2026, Class I). Customers who received the product should stop selling it and hold it for pickup.

Halvard Cooling & Pack Co. Issues Voluntary Recall

Halvard Cooling & Pack Co. of Salinas, CA is voluntarily recalling fresh cilantro, bunched, 30 bunches per case. Potential contamination with Cyclospora cayetanensis, linked by state health officials to a cluster of illnesses.

Affected product: Lot codes PK260831007 printed on the case label, packed August 31, 2026.
Distributed to wholesale distributors and food service operators in CA and NV. Approximately 92 cases are involved.

The recall was initiated on September 8, 2026 in cooperation with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (recall F-2170-2026, Class II). Customers who received the product should stop selling it and hold it for pickup.

Tule Bend Growers Issues Voluntary Recall

Tule Bend Growers of Oxnard, CA is voluntarily recalling fresh Roma tomatoes, 25 lb cartons. Potential contamination with Salmonella Newport associated with packing-shed wash water.

Affected product: All Roma tomatoes harvested between September 25, 2026 and September 27, 2026 from Tule Bend Growers (Oxnard, CA). Cartons carry the grower harvest lot code.
Product was sold to a packer/cooler in Salinas, CA, which repacked and further distributed it to wholesalers in CA and NV. Approximately 320 cases are involved.

The recall was initiated on October 4, 2026 in cooperation with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (recall F-1915-2026, Class II). Customers who received the product should stop selling it and hold it for pickup.
